subject: Order form: payment cadence, tax residency & PO routing
messages:
From: Jose Santiago <j.santiago@hyperioninc.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: legal.ops@hyperioninc.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order Form + PO timing for Q4 commit

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Hyperion is ready to move forward with the Q4 commit but we need to confirm a couple of billing items before we sign:

- Payment cadence: our AP team prefers Net45 (internal policy), but we can be flexible if Redwood needs Net30. Can you confirm what you can accept for the initial invoice?
- PO routing: attaching our PO stub (Hyperion_PO_1234.pdf). Please confirm the exact invoice fields we must include so AP will process without delay.
- Tax residency: Hyperion is an EU entity (Portugal). We will provide a tax residency certificate — can you confirm whether Redwood will gross-up or will Hyperion withhold VAT/withholding tax? If withholding applies, any evidence Redwood needs?

Can you also confirm currency preference (we prefer EUR) and whether Redwood can issue invoices in EUR. We need to close the order this week.

Attaching PO.

Regards,
Jose Santiago
Head of Procurement, Hyperion Inc
Attachments: Hyperion_PO_1234.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Jose Santiago <j.santiago@hyperioninc.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order Form + PO timing for Q4 commit

Thanks Jose — quick answers and next steps below.

1) Payment cadence: Our standard is Net30. For new enterprise customers we can accept Net45 for the first invoice as a one-time accommodation if the PO is in place and we have the billing contact + remittance instructions on file. After the first invoice we’d expect Net30 going forward (we can document this in the order form).

2) PO routing/invoice fields: please ensure the PO number appears on every invoice. We need: PO number, billing contact (name + email), VAT ID, and remit instructions (bank wiring details).

3) Tax/residency: please send the tax residency certificate. If Hyperion is subject to any withholding under Portugal rules, Redwood will follow local tax treatment. We typically invoice gross and allow the customer to withhold if required; where withholding is material we ask for documentation (tax certificate) and will provide an invoice credit or gross-up based on the order form language — we can include an explicit withholding clause in the redline.

4) Currency: we can issue invoices in EUR. Note: our contract lists USD as primary, but the order form can specify EUR billing for this account; FX exposure remains the customer’s responsibility unless we add an FX clause.

I've attached a redline of the order form focused on invoicing, currency, and tax language (redline_orderform_v3.docx). Can Kimberly and Laura confirm whether we should accept Net45 for the first invoice and what supporting docs we require?

Next steps: Jose — please upload the tax cert and confirm AP email for invoice routing. I’ll loop Legal and Finance for the final wording.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Manager, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order Form + PO timing for Q4 commit

Evelyn — thanks. My take:

- Approve Net45 for first invoice only. We should add a one-off commitment in the order form: "first invoice Net45; subsequent invoices Net30 unless otherwise agreed in writing."
- Require VAT ID and official tax residency certificate (signed/issued by tax authority) before we accept withholding. If Hyperion withholds, we need the percentage, statutory reference, and certificate so we can evaluate gross-up vs credit.
- Ask AP to copy legal.ops@hyperioninc.com on remittance instructions so Legal can track withholding evidence.
- For currency: allow EUR invoicing but include an invoice footnote that payments received in EUR will be applied as invoiced; FX gains/losses are the customer's responsibility.

I'll draft a short Finance Addendum for inclusion in the order form to capture the above (invoice routing, PO on invoice, tax evidence requirements, first-invoice Net45).

Kimberly Park
Senior Director, Revenue Operations

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

- Add a short clause that if withholding occurs, Hyperion will provide certified evidence and Redwood will re-evaluate invoice credits/gross-up on a case-by-case basis.

I have prepared the final DocuSign packet — please sign when ready: https://docusign.net/req/abc123
